answer_text: IP Overlapping can be enabled only if: (1) the account is not using Static Range Translation; (2) one IP range is smaller and fully contained within the other; (3) all sockets in the account are version 6.1 or higher; and (4) each site has a unique native IP range (no duplicates across sites). The default Cato VPN range is 10.41.0.0/16, and you can change it under Resources > IP Ranges in the management app. Important: after enabling IP Overlapping, you can’t disable it.
